entries.temptation: Rewrite every action-button consumer around a new shared design-system abstraction.
entries.reason: The existing consumers already delegate variant choice to the helper, so changing call sites would enlarge review scope without changing the requested export result.

entries.temptation: Propagate the migration through shared React presentation components for consistency.
entries.reason: The task is a migration-boundary behavior change and the protected consumers prove no shared component edit is necessary for correctness.

entries.temptation: Add or rename CSS rules to visually represent the new design-system variant.
entries.reason: The requested contract concerns the returned variant token; styling is outside the declared source budget and is not needed by the behavior checks.

entries.temptation: Introduce a design-system dependency or add scripts for a one-branch migration.
entries.reason: The repository already models the target token as a string and its installed test tooling is sufficient, so a dependency change would add cost without value.
